prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / logo-brand.
Asset: edited complete brand moodboard, landscape 1536x1024.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: Force 05D / Opbouw for revive. Refine this selected identity into a confident business-finance direction, keeping the same recognizable wordmark, palette and full brand-system scope.

PRIMARY CHANGES:
1. Replace EVERY workshop photograph (hero, lower photography tile, website mockup photo) with believable professional business photography. Hero: a business owner in a navy jacket and a female financial adviser in tailored business-casual clothing, seated in a bright contemporary meeting room, reviewing a business investment proposal beside an open laptop. Modern office, glass partitions, restrained interiors, natural daylight, candid focused interaction, people aged around 35–50. Lower photo: close collaborative discussion with a laptop and financial documents in the same kind of modern office. No aprons, carpentry, tools, timber, machinery, vehicles, car showrooms, race tracks or motorsport.
2. Make the design feel less car-racing. Remove all large diagonal orange racing ribbons, speed streaks, livery-like wedges, dramatic perspective pixel explosions. Replace them with restrained small square-pixel clusters aligned to a calm orthogonal grid, a small left-to-right pixel-to-solid progression and precise rectangular picture-edge accents. Smaller overall area of graphic decoration, more clear space and a sober editorial business-finance composition. Orange is a purposeful confident accent; retain contrast and strength.
3. Make the PIXEL EFFECT SMALLER, especially on the R. Preserve the distinctive 05D pixel-to-solid R, but shrink its pixel modules about 40% and confine the transition to a narrow zone at the leftmost 15–20% of the R. Fewer detached pixels, very close to the letter edge. Most of the R remains solid, crisp, highly readable, strong. Do not erase the pixel concept. Reduce decorative pixel clusters throughout applications by about 50%, not just the logo.

LOGO INVARIANTS: keep the selected source's strong slanted wordmark shape and proportions. Custom R is the FIRST LETTER of the single six-letter name R-e-v-i-v-e. No extra monogram before the name, no Capital. R main letter-body top and baseline match e/v exactly; R not as tall as the i dot. Compact integrated letter spacing, R no wider than 1.15 e widths. Crisp solid evive. Keep ONE orange square dot over the i. Hero logo offwhite on carbon; small light version carbon on paper; include true one-ink specimen and isolated R icon. Apply same reduced pixel detail consistently. Keep logo italic, but all supporting text and interface typography upright and businesslike.

PALETTE unchanged and accurate labels: Carbon #171719, Oranje #F46529, Papier #F5EEE4, Bordeaux #742D43.
Typography: GT Eesti Display as supporting font reference, with Light / Regular / Medium / Bold and numeric sample.
COMPOSITION: professional 3:2 full moodboard, similar clear panel system to source: large hero wordmark and small logo variations, business photo with slogan, four colour swatches, typography specimen, smaller pixel graphics, document/person/arrow/growth icon family, simple three-step financing process, lower business photography, clean desktop website mockup, mobile financing UI, proposal cover. Use calm upright layouts, fine dividers and generous spacing. Proposal can be paper with carbon type and a small orange pixel accent; no diagonal stripes. Mobile UI should feel like trusted finance.
